parsing_traps: Trap #8 (consolidated vs attributable NPI): Consolidated NPI = $215,905,000 (directly held properties only, p63). Attributable NPI = $381,364,000 including JV share and rental support (p178). BOTH are prominently disclosed. Consolidated figure stored in performance.json as primary.

Trap #7 (100% vs proportionate valuations): OFC — valuation table uses Keppel's 79.9% interest ($2,301.1M) while Portfolio Statement carries 100% ($2,880M). T Tower — valuation $269.7M (99.4% basis) vs carrying $271.3M (100% basis). KR Ginza $85.0M vs $86.4M. All dual values captured in properties.json alt_value fields.

Trap #9 (JV properties outside consolidated totals): ORQ, MBFC T1&2+MBLM, MBFC T3, 8 Chifley, DMJC — equity-accounted, valuations at Keppel's proportionate interest, NPI excluded from consolidated total. Reconciliation section documents this.

Trap #12 (distributable income layering): Distribution Statement shows income available including opening balance ($320,277,000 total available), of which $276,593,000 was distributed. The headline 'Distribution to Unitholders' in income statement = $212,406,000 (cash distributions accrued in FY2025 P&L). net_distributable_income uses the income statement figure.

Top Ryde City Shopping Centre acquired 19 December 2025 — only 12 days contribution in FY2025. GR and NPI both $699,000. NPI = gross revenue (no separate opex lines) per Note 32 — likely immaterial period.
